rationale: The replaceable-phenotype, method-slot and evolution-plane view composes existing runtime, routing, governance and provenance mechanisms into one provisional self-description. The exact R0 decomposition is new; the parts are not wholly new.
authority_ceiling: Research-only provisional model; explicitly not the essence, a canonical authority or proof of capability.
residual: No independent measurement establishes that these slots describe a functioning or transferable cognitive process.

rationale: Stable IDs, evidence, provenance, boundaries and uncertainty existed in separate authorities. Task179 adds a versioned, separate cognitive-object/relation graph and explicit UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN_RELATION composition; its own crosswalk calls this representation a real gap.
authority_ceiling: Research-only platform provenance; no promotion into Foundation or Current.
residual: The schema establishes a carrier, not that a model can construct or use a valid method graph.

rationale: Operations and migrations record changes, but Task179 introduces a named typed contract joining predecessor, anomaly, reframing, new representation/method, evaluation, ADOPT/REJECT/COEXIST/UNRESOLVED, migration lineage and unknowns. The Task179 crosswalk classifies this explicit record as a real gap before R0.
authority_ceiling: Research-only record; a code diff/complete record is not a verdict or proof of evolution.
residual: Record completeness and actual method improvement/transfer are not independently measured.

rationale: Stance-blind review, evidence-source separation and independent review precede Task179. R0 composes frozen objectives/criteria, blind-first order, role-specific write surfaces, fixtures and explicit metrics in one package; its crosswalk calls the prior plane partial rather than absent.
authority_ceiling: Specified workflow only; evaluator assignment is waiting and all metrics are not yet measured.
residual: Task185 does not use Task180 result files or verdict as evidence and does not run an evaluator.

rationale: Provider/runtime capability descriptions and registries already exist. Task179 adds cognitive serialize/validate/transition/reconstruct contracts, unbound provider/model fields and rediscovery triggers; calibration is explicitly NOT_YET_MEASURED or MECHANICAL_ONLY.
authority_ceiling: Interface metadata only; no provider binding, capability result or self-improvement claim.
residual: General capability profile reconstruction after model/provider change is not demonstrated.

rationale: Runtime already bounds actions, writes, time and output, while prior control-plane documents examine subtraction. Task179 newly composes schema-family/dependency/authority counts with consumer, downgrade/merge/delete conditions and retirement/replay obligations; its crosswalk calls this specific harness-retirement budget a real gap.
authority_ceiling: Research-only accounting; no automated deletion/retirement and no universal complexity score.
residual: No measured governance-overhead baseline or accepted retirement decision is supplied.

rationale: Checkpoint/resume, handoff and operation lineage pre-exist. The new package composes those with source fixtures, cognitive-object/transition pointers, capability interface, reconstruction contract, open obligations and explicit non-inference ceiling without relying on Builder chat history.
authority_ceiling: Handoff/reconstruction contract; package status is READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION and is not evidence of successor execution.
residual: Whether a successor can reconstruct and continue correctly is not established by package conformance.

rationale: Legacy migration and provenance adapters pre-exist. R0 adds a backward-readable adapter specifically to cognitive IR, preserving unknown relations and asserting destructive_rewrite=false.
authority_ceiling: Fixture-level compatibility contract; no population-wide migration or canonical rewrite.
residual: A single fixture does not establish safety for all future versions or unknown schemas.

rationale: Task181 composes typed EVALUATION_EVIDENCE path classification, provenance hashing, shared admission exclusions for function/nonfunction discovery and regression fixtures. This is a concrete new cross-surface isolation path over existing path-accounting/admission patterns.
authority_ceiling: Mechanically enforced non-discovery and audit-only evaluation evidence; not evaluator acceptance or a truth boundary change.
residual: Isolation effectiveness is a repository admission property; it does not prove a sealed protocol is cognitively independent.

rationale: Foundation already prohibits authority escalation and distinguishes canonical claims from candidates. R0 makes explicit that transitions are at most repository-local candidates; Task181's matching-source transition helper stops at ADJUDICATION_CANDIDATE_ONLY and has no write side effect.
authority_ceiling: No Foundation/Current promotion, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
residual: A candidate-only record still needs the separately authorized adjudication path; no automatic promotion is inferred.

rationale: Task181 specifies a manifest allowlist, separate read-ledger schema, pre-registration of source anchors, and separation of successor-visible material from evaluator-only criteria. The classification concerns the protocol contract only; no Task182-R1 payload, gold, sealed file or output is used.
authority_ceiling: Procedural allowlisting, not cryptographic secrecy; it does not authorize a successor run.
residual: Task185 does not inspect packet contents or infer any downstream compliance/result.
